walkthrough.text:
Identify the outcomes satisfying the given condition $X > -1$:
$$X > -1 \iff X \in \{0, 1, 3\}$$
$$P(X > -1) = 1 - P(X = -2) = 1 - 0.1 = 0.9$$

Identify the outcomes that are both in the condition and are odd integers:
$$X \in \{0, 1, 3\} \text{ and } X \text{ is odd} \iff X \in \{1, 3\}$$
$$P(X \in \{1, 3\}) = P(X = 1) + P(X = 3) = 0.3 + 0.2 = 0.5$$

Compute the conditional probability and simplify:
$$P(X \text{ is odd} \mid X > -1) = \frac{P(X \in \{1, 3\})}{P(X > -1)} = \frac{0.5}{0.9} = \frac{5}{9}$$

Take the ratio and simplify to lowest terms:
$$P = \frac{0.5}{0.9} = \frac{5}{9}$$
